{"subject":"Checking in on Pylon","body":"Hi there,

I've been thinking about Pylon lately and wanted to check in to see how things are going. I'd love to hear what you and the team have been building and what's on your mind for the months ahead.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call whenever suits you, no agenda beyond catching up and seeing if there's anything I can help with.

Hope the team is doing well.

Daniel"}
